top_signals.title: Nvidia’s Board CEO Hunt, Stocks Finish Week Higher, Retail in Focus
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg Television brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Franklin Templeton Institute’s Head Market Strategist Chris Galipeau, Pershing Square’s Founder and CEO Bill Ackman, London Business School Leadership Institute’s Founding Director Randall Peterson, Committee For A Responsible Federal Budget’s President Maya MacGuineas, Real Macro’s CEO and Founder Jeff Currie, Northwestern Mutual Wealth’s Chief Portfolio Manager of Equities Matt Stucky, National Academy of Engineering’s President Tse-Jae King Liu, Exemplar Luxury Group’s CEO Geoffroy van Raemdonck, Rent the Runway’s President and CEO Paige Thomas, Grammy Award Winning Singer and Hinote’s Co-Founder Carrie Underwood, Hinote’s CEO and Co-Founder Kerrigan Behrens. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Who Runs the Ransomware Group Qilin?
top_signals.summary: The cybercrime group Qilin has emerged as the world's most active ransomware affiliate program, claiming at least 365 victim organizations in the past three months alone. But even top Russian hackers make operational security mistakes, and the administrator of Qilin has made a few key missteps over the last decade that all point to a 36-year-old man living in St. Petersburg, Russia.
